people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
translations.bsb: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. “Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?” He asked Peter.
translations.kjv: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
